BUTTERY SMOOTH & SOFT - Ready for ultimate comfort? With our Elegant Pattern sheets, you'll be reveling in soothing softness. The secret is in our high quality, tightly knit, microfiber fabric. Our linens are double-brushed for creamy smoothness, and are softer than silk. Already beautifully packaged, with a tassel-trim zipper for easy access & storage, this comfy bedset is the perfect wedding or housewarming gift for cozy sleepers!

DURABLE & BREATHABLE - Why are our Cosy House sheets a great choice? Stronger than even the highest thread count Egyptian cotton, these luxury hotel style sheets resist fading, last longer compared to other brands, and are incredibly durable. You'll be able to rest easy in summer or winter - all year round - because of our elegant, breathable, plush bed sheets.

DEEP POCKETED  FITTED SHEETS - Our signature cooling sheets and bedding are stretchy and can fit up to 16 inch mattresses. Plus, it has elastic all around (not just at corners), so it stays snug and secure all night long. To top it off, each Twin sized bedset includes 1 Fitted Sheet, 1 Flat Sheet, and 1 Pillowcase. Pick your favorite color or a patterned set, and you'll be ready for a luxe, comfortable, slumber.

EASY CARE - These sheets are machine washable and dryer friendly! Our bed sheets like ours ward off common non-living allergens and are odor, stain, and wrinkle resistant. No need for ironing. You won't even break a sweat! Say goodbye to stinky sheets, because ours stay fresher for longer. Wash in cold water and tumble dry on low heat to avoid pilling.

PEACE OF MIND - Boasting a gorgeous matte-&-shine pattern for wallet friendly prices, our 1800 sheets are guaranteed high quality for less. They come in a variety of colors and styles, and are carefully crafted and made from mindful materials. We care about our Cosy community and are here for you every step of the way.
